# Villa Home Detail

> Premium, background-checked residential house cleaning for Austin's westside neighborhoods (West Lake Hills, Tarrytown, Barton Creek). Same two-person team every visit, instant online quote, satisfaction guaranteed.

## Company facts

- Villa Home Detail provides recurring, deep-clean, move-in/move-out, and post-construction cleaning for homes in West Lake Hills, Tarrytown, and Barton Creek, TX.
- Every client is assigned the same two-person team for every visit — not a rotating crew.
- All team members pass a background check before entering a client home.
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 8:00am–6:00pm.
- Phone: +1 (512) 745-7488.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://villahomedetail.com/): Services, service areas, before/after gallery, FAQ, and contact form.

## Services

- Recurring Care — weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly visits from the same two-person team.
- Deep Clean — a comprehensive reset for every room, the standard every recurring visit is measured against.
- Move-In / Move-Out — full-home cleaning for a move transition.
- Post-Construction — fine dust removal after a renovation or build.
